newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Oct wholesale prices up 3.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Thai Oct wholesale prices up 3.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) rose 3.5 percent year-on-year in October against a 3.0 percent increase in the previous month, the Commerce Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said wholesale prices rose 0.9 percent in October from September against a 0.2 percent month-on-month increase in the previous month.
The ministry said the 1985-based index rose to 157.4 in October from its 152.1 level in October 1995.
